administered in the u.s. scott pauley, a spokesperson for the cdc, told the ap that outside of nine deaths confirmed to be associated with rare blood clots following the johnson & johnson vaccine, the agency has not detected any unusual or unexpected patterns for deaths following immunization that would indicate that covid vaccines are causing or contributing to deaths. tsai said likely reasons for excess deaths in this age group since 2020 include suicides, homicides, heart diseases, liver disease, diabetes and accidental deaths including drug overdoses. he added that a substantial number of
